question_text: A document must pass through three approval stages in order: (1) Division Chief, (2) Department Manager, (3) Director. The routing sheet shows the following signatures: Stage 1: Division Chief (signed), Stage 2: Director (signed), Stage 3: Department Manager (signed). Is the routing correct?

options.text: Yes, because all required stages are signed.
No, because the Director signed before the Department Manager.
No, because the Division Chief should sign last.
Yes, because the order does not matter as long as all sign.
